title: AXP publisher key directory
description: Served at https://<publisher>/.well-known/agent-extension-keys.json (SPEC section 8.5): the keys a publisher currently signs with. Hosts consult it when a manifest's signing key differs from the pinned one (rotation must move to a listed key; a listed new key with the pinned key delisted is a lost-key recovery that needs the user's explicit consent) and may consult it on first use (strict mode). With roles (section 14.3) it also names the online keys that sign entitlements; an entry without roles signs manifests only. Unknown fields are ignored.

publisher.description: The publisher DNS name; when present it MUST equal the domain the document is served from.

extensions.description: Restrict this key to these extensions: bare names are the publisher's own, full <publisher>/<name> ids may name other publishers' extensions this key issues entitlements for (section 14.3); absent = every extension.

roles.description: What this key signs: manifest and/or entitlement (section 14.3). Absent = manifest only, so existing directories keep their meaning. An entitlement key is held online by the issuing service; listing it without the manifest role is what keeps a stolen issuing key from ever moving a host's pin.

revoked.description: A revoked key is listed so hosts can tell 'replaced' from 'never ours'; it never vouches for anything.
